title: Organise pages
description: Reorder, rotate, insert, delete, extract and merge pages.

steps.title: Select pages
steps.text: Open the Thumbnails tab in the sidebar. Click a page to select it. Hold Ctrl to add more pages, or Shift to select a range.

steps.title: Drag to reorder
steps.text: Drag the selected thumbnail or thumbnails up or down the list and drop them where you want them to go.

steps.title: Rotate pages
steps.text: With pages selected, click Rotate right to turn them 90 degrees clockwise. Rotate left is the button beside it.

steps.title: Open the Pages menu
steps.text: Click Pages. Here you can choose Delete pages…, Insert blank page, Insert from file…, Extract / Split… and Merge files….

steps.title: Undo a mistake
steps.text: Click Undo (Ctrl+Z) to reverse the last change, such as a move, a rotation or a deletion.

steps.title: Save the result
steps.text: Click Save, or use Save as to keep the original file as it was.
